---
title: Code block style, filename bar on a light page with a dark code block (idiomatic)
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    syntax-highlighting: idiomatic
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

The page keeps its light background, and the brand gives code blocks a dark background.
The style keeps `stroke`, `surface` and `label` at `auto`, so the filename bar, its label and the frame must take the colours that match the code block fill.

```{=typst}
#show "example.py": it => context {
  if text.fill == luma(225) { counter("cbs-label").step() }
  it
}
#show block: it => {
  if it.fill == luma(55) { counter("cbs-surface").step() }
  if type(it.stroke) == stroke and it.stroke.paint == luma(100) { counter("cbs-frame").step() }
  it
}
```

```{.python filename="example.py"}
x = 1
```

```{=typst}
#context {
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-surface").final().first(), 1, message: "expected 1 filename bar with the surface for the code block fill")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-label").final().first(), 1, message: "expected the filename in the label colour for the code block fill")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-frame").final().first(), 1, message: "expected the frame in the stroke for the code block fill")
}
```
